subject: maths
question:
The following pie charts show the number of students studying in different departments of an institute during the academic years 2019 and 2020. The total number of students was 2000 and 2400, respectively, in the academic years 2019 and 2020.

What are the ratio of Commerce and Computer Science students taken together in 2019 to Engineering and Medical students taken together in 2020?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2445af22939674a1f9fc9ad88d66ed3a289717ad47e7a710a07f4fd5b55fb26.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/739cd03cbefc989853deed5fa2e8a8c9de5093771740ec2d6adddf71d0c0f749.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total students who took Commerce and Computer in 2019 = 2000 × (25 + 14)%

⇒ 2000 × 39%

⇒ 780

Total students who took Engineering and Medical in 2020 = 2400 × (12+ 10)%

⇒ 2400 × 22%

⇒ 528

Now,

Ratio = 780 : 528

⇒ 65 : 44

**∴ Required answer is 65 : 44.**
